_comment: Frozen 2026-08-22. See holdout.py and experiments/README.md. Do not edit the boundary.
reason: Six hypotheses had already been tested against the full sample by this date (logged in the project's research notes). Every further test on the same data makes any positive result less believable: measured on the order-gate experiment, a random ranking scored at its best over 7 pre-registrable choices reached the reported effect size in 15.9% of draws. A genuine holdout is the only thing that restores the ability to believe a result.
rules: Develop, tune, and explore ONLY on data before holdout_start.
Pre-register the exact rule and the exact statistic BEFORE running the holdout.
Run the holdout ONCE per pre-registered hypothesis. Log it below.
A hypothesis that fails the holdout is dead. Do not tune it and re-run.

hypotheses_tested_on_holdout.hypothesis: Equal-weight portfolio of tsmom --vol-target 0.20 sleeves on BTC/ETH/XRP/LTC at 4h, gross capped at 100%, judged on portfolio excess Sharpe versus an equal-weight buy-and-hold basket of the same four assets. PASS = excess Sharpe > 0. Secondary: max drawdown reduction >= 2x versus the basket. Dev-data reference: +0.52 overall, +0.58 and +0.34 in the two halves, drawdown reduced 3.3-3.6x.
hypotheses_tested_on_holdout.note: First holdout look of the project. Dev window ended 2024-01-01.

hypotheses_tested_on_holdout.hypothesis: UNREGISTERED (logged after the fact): twelve 'tournament' runs, ~53,000 genomes across 24 strategy families, used holdout windows starting 2022-02..2023-08 that all CONTAIN the frozen 2024+ window. Also the LPPLS 14-instrument transfer test, a 200-seed matched-null control sweep on the BTC 2023+ window, and post-hoc portfolio sweeps (timing-rule comparison, vol-target ladder, 8-sleeve widening) on 2024+.
hypotheses_tested_on_holdout.note: Protocol violation, self-reported 2026-08-24. All looks returned negative or within-noise results, so no positive claim was manufactured - but 2024+ is now SPENT as a holdout for the 24 registry families and for tsmom portfolio variations. Only data after forward_tests[0].start is clean.

contamination.status: 2024+ is contaminated for all 24 registry strategy families and for tsmom portfolio variations (weights, vol targets, universe size). Results measured on it are DESCRIPTIVE, not out-of-sample.

forward_tests.name: paper-8sleeve-tsmom
forward_tests.hypothesis: Equal-weight paper portfolio of 8 tsmom --vol-target 0.20 sleeves (BTC/ETH/XRP/LTC/DOGE/TRX/ADA/SOL_USDT, 4h), gross capped at 100%, run live-forward in paper mode. Judged on data from start_epoch onward, no earlier than 2027-08-25 (>=12 months). PRIMARY: portfolio max drawdown <= 0.5x the equal-weight buy-and-hold basket's max drawdown over the identical window. SECONDARY (directional only, stated in advance as underpowered): portfolio excess Sharpe over the basket > 0. VALIDITY GATE: parity signal match rate ~100% on every sleeve; if the bots did not trade the measured strategy, the test is void, not failed.
forward_tests.note: Forward data is the only clean holdout remaining after the 2026-08-24 contamination. Cold-start fills (positions inherited mid-trend at start) are excluded from the drawdown comparison's entry prices by judging both legs on the same window's price path, not on entry P&L.
forward_tests.status: TERMINATED 2026-08-25 by operator decision, before its start date and before any forward data accrued. 0 looks taken. The test is VOID, not failed - nothing was measured. State archived to archive/state_8sleeve_tsmom_20260825.

forward_tests.name: paper-8sleeve-ensemble
forward_tests.hypothesis: Equal-weight paper portfolio of 8 ensemble_vote sleeves (majority vote of tsmom + faber_ma + donchian at published defaults, enter at 2 votes, exit at <=1) with --vol-target 0.20, same universe and window as paper-8sleeve-tsmom. Judged no earlier than 2027-08-25. PRIMARY: portfolio max drawdown <= 0.5x the EW basket's over the identical window. SECONDARY: portfolio Sharpe >= the paper-8sleeve-tsmom book's (rule diversification should not cost risk-adjusted return). VALIDITY GATE: parity signal match ~100% per sleeve.
forward_tests.note: Dev-only evidence (pre-2024, 4 sleeves, vt=0.20): ensemble Sharpe 1.74 vs members 1.64-1.66, maxDD 18.4% vs tsmom 27.8%; split halves +0.99/+0.06 excess - second half barely positive, so the Sharpe claim is weak and the drawdown claim is the primary here too. No 2024+ data was used to build or select it.

amendments.change: The SECONDARY criterion referenced the paper-8sleeve-tsmom book, which was terminated before start. Secondary criterion is now: portfolio excess Sharpe over the equal-weight buy-and-hold basket > 0 (directional only, underpowered, as originally stated). PRIMARY criterion (drawdown <= 0.5x basket) and validity gate are unchanged.

The paper book was stopped by operator decision after ~1 day of forward data. The test's measurement vehicle is now the LIVE book (state_live/): identical strategy and configuration (ensemble_vote, 8 sleeves, --vol-target 0.20, $125/sleeve via --quote-cap), real fills instead of simulated ones. Criteria, start date (2026-08-25) and earliest read date (2027-08-25) are unchanged. Real fills make the test STRICTER, not looser: actual fees (0.125%) and real spreads replace modeled costs. Paper state preserved in state_ensemble/, resumable.

Book scaled from $1,000 to the full account by operator decision: $487/sleeve caps (8 x 487 = $3,896 of the ~$3,898 USDT). Done on day ~0 of the test window, before meaningful data accrued, so the test effectively measures the full-size book from the start. Positions open at the time (sized against the old $125 caps) resize at their next entry, not mid-trade. Criteria and dates unchanged.

Sizing changed on the live book from --vol-target 0.20 (30-bar vol window) to --vol-target 0.30 with --vol-window 90, after ~1 day of forward data. Chosen from a dev-only ladder (addendum 13): Sharpe flat across 0.20-0.40, so this is a risk-level choice, not a new hypothesis; the 90-bar window is a measured drawdown reducer. Criteria unchanged. Note the PRIMARY criterion (drawdown <= 0.5x basket) becomes HARDER to pass at the higher target since strategy drawdown scales with it while the basket's does not.

TERMINATED. Two unregistered changes to the measured configuration: sizing moved to --vol-target 0.30 --vol-window 90 (applied to the live book ~2026-08-26 without an amendment - a protocol lapse, recorded here), and on 2026-08-26 the exit rule changed from exitVotes=1 to exitVotes=0 by operator decision after a 129-variant dev sweep (PROFITABILITY_PLAN.md addendum 15). ~1.5 days of forward data accrued under the original spec; 0 looks taken. VOID, not failed. Successor: live-8sleeve-ensemble-exit0.

forward_tests.name: live-8sleeve-ensemble-exit0
forward_tests.hypothesis: LIVE book (state_live/, real fills) of 8 equal-weight sleeves (BTC/ETH/XRP/LTC/DOGE/TRX/ADA/SOL_USDT, 4h) running ensemble_vote with enterVotes=2, exitVotes=0 (long while >=2 of {tsmom,faber_ma,donchian} want long; flat only once all three have quit), --vol-target 0.30 --vol-window 90, $487/sleeve via --quote-cap. Judged on data from start_epoch onward, no earlier than 2027-08-26 (>=12 months). PRIMARY: portfolio max drawdown <= 0.5x the equal-weight buy-and-hold basket's over the identical window. SECONDARY (directional, underpowered, stated in advance): portfolio excess Sharpe over the basket > 0. VALIDITY GATE: parity signal match ~100% per sleeve.
forward_tests.note: Adopted AGAINST the pre-registered adoption rule of addendum 15 (0/129 variants passed; this rule trails the previous live rule on the burnt 2024+ window: 1.10 vs 1.42 Sharpe, 28.8% vs 18.6% DD, descriptive). Operator decision, made with that stated. Dev evidence: Sharpe 1.62 vs 1.24, maxDD 23.5% vs 20.8% (6 pairs, vt 0.30/90 vs 0.20/30), 1/3 the trades. Known cost: deeper per-sleeve drawdowns (XRP 63% vs 31% on dev). Positions open at the switch were carried over unchanged and remain sized at their entry-time parameters.
